gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (p5, GAAP/modified accrual) vs the budgetary comparison schedules (pp12-16, budgetary basis, 'Total resources'). General Fund statement total revenues 24,767,512 vs budget schedule 24,889,811 (p12) = -122,299 (e.g. property 6,477,473 vs 6,505,540, intergovernmental 1,612,015 vs 1,601,465, charges for services 4,252,154 vs 4,343,429, interest 1,081,013 vs 1,094,520); Street 5,092,656 vs 5,057,498 (p14) = 35,158; Museum 1,970,895 vs 1,975,222 (p15) = -4,327; Debt Service 1,653,898 vs 1,656,494 (p16) = -2,596; Other Governmental Funds 4,772,827 = nonmajor combining statement (pp17-20) 4,772,827, no difference. -122,299 + 35,158 - 4,327 - 2,596 = -94,064 = the gap (schedule above statement). Detail lines sum to each printed schedule total; nothing missing or duplicated. No fix.

Statement (p5, GAAP) vs budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis, 'Total charges to appropriations'): General Fund 23,774,489 vs 23,299,724 (pp12-13; general government 5,655,547 + public safety 11,250,201 + public works 888,753 + environment and leisure 5,505,223) = 474,765; Street 4,048,770 vs 4,142,693 (p14) = -93,923; Museum 1,791,015 vs 1,793,660 (p15) = -2,645; Debt Service 467,883 vs 470,181 (p16) = -2,298; Other Governmental Funds 6,962,601 = nonmajor combining statement (pp17-20) 6,962,601. 474,765 - 93,923 - 2,645 - 2,298 = 375,899 = the gap. All printed budget-schedule lines are in detail[]; the printed totals differ by basis. No fix.
